skills.description: Requests a preferred item using a single word or sign
skills.examples: Says or signs "juice" to request juice at snack time

skills.description: Combines two words to form a simple request
Answers a simple wh- question about a shared activity
skills.examples: Answers "what color?" while pointing at an object

skills.description: Follows a one-step direction involving a familiar object

skills.examples: "Pick up the cup and put it on the table"

skills.description: Engages with a single toy appropriately for at least one minute
skills.examples: Stacks blocks, rolls a car back and forth

skills.description: Transitions independently between two play activities
skills.examples: Moves from blocks to a puzzle without prompting

skills.description: Takes turns with a peer during a simple game
skills.examples: Rolls a ball back and forth, waits for a turn in a board game

skills.description: Initiates a play interaction with a peer
skills.examples: Invites another child to play by name or gesture

skills.description: Uses a spoon to self-feed without spilling most of the bite
skills.examples: Eats cereal or yogurt with a spoon

skills.description: Pours liquid from a small pitcher into a cup
skills.examples: Pours water from a child-sized pitcher
